EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a clear S–H stretch at 2508 cm⁻¹ together with the characteristic S–H bending mode at 1203 cm⁻¹ (rule GFQ-005). Only candidate 3 (CNC(=S)S) contains an –SH group. It also has an N–H bond, matching the 3200–3317 cm⁻¹ N–H stretches (rule GFQ-002), and C–S/C=S vibrations that can account for the strong 734 cm⁻¹ band and the 855–935 cm⁻¹ region. The aliphatic C–H stretches at 2837–2988 cm⁻¹ fit the methyl group present. No other candidate simultaneously provides S–H, N–H and aliphatic C–H functional groups, so candidate 3 best matches the experimental Raman peaks.
